name: Portainer
description: Browse Portainer environments, stacks and containers from DBX, inspect resource usage and read container logs, with MCP tools for AI clients.

versions.releaseNotes: Initial release. Environment, stack and container browsing with health badges, database container discovery with ready-to-use DBX connection parameters, container logs (auto refresh, range, search, download, line selection) and resource statistics. Read-only: every Portainer request is a GET.

Adds an MCP tool surface: the plugin now implements the DBX mcp/tools and mcp/call methods and exposes nine read-only tools (environment overview, environments, stacks, containers, container search, database discovery with connection parameters, container inspect, container logs with range/tail/timestamp/search, container stats). Containers can be addressed by name or id. Also ships a reusable, dependency-free MCP support package (backend/mcp) for other plugins. Everything remains read-only.
